chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah b. Ja'far al-Himyari narrated to us, from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi'l Khattab, from al-Hasan b. Mahbub, from Ibrahim b. Muhzim, from Talha b. Zayd, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both). He said:
Pray over anyone who dies from the people of the qibla. His judgment is with Allah the Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ: People of the qibla - those who face Mecca in prayer, i.e. Muslims
key_terms.حِسَابُهُ: His reckoning/judgment - the accounting of deeds before Allah
key_terms.صَلِّ: Pray (the funeral prayer) - specifically the salat al-janaza

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about performing funeral prayer for Muslims regardless of their standing?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir, as transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq, instructs that the funeral prayer should be performed for every Muslim who dies - anyone who faces the qibla (direction of prayer toward Mecca). The judgment of their inner faith and deeds is left entirely to Allah. This teaching was given in the context of early Islamic debates about who deserved funeral rites, establishing that external Muslim identity through facing the qibla was sufficient grounds for the prayer, without passing judgment on the deceased's personal beliefs or sins.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Ibrahim b. Muhzim from Talha b. Zayd from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father (as).  He said:
Pray over anyone who dies from the people of the qibla. His judgment is with Allah.
